name: Flash of Insight
body:
School divination; Level magus 2, sorcerer/wizard 2, witch 2

CASTING

Casting Time 1 swift action
Components V

EFFECT

Range personal
Target you
Duration 1 round
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

Peering into the immediate future, you guide your attack with the knowledge of your opponent’s actions. Your next single attack roll (if made before the end of the round in which you cast the spell) gains a +1 insight bonus for every three caster levels you possess (minimum +1).
